query: How do I propagate a pothos plant from cuttings?
answer: To propagate pothos, cut a healthy vine about ¼ inch below a node. A node is the small brown bump where a leaf joins the stem. Roots only grow from nodes, so a leaf with no node won't root. A cutting with a few leaves and nodes works well [1][2]. Strip off any leaves that would sit underwater, then put the cutting in a glass of water so the nodes are submerged and the leaves stay above the waterline. Plain tap water is fine [2][3]. Keep it in bright, indirect light and change the water every 7–10 days to keep it fresh and oxygenated. Cuttings root fastest in spring through late summer [2][3]. If a stem goes soft and mushy, throw it out [3]. When the roots are about an inch long, you can pot the cutting in soil or just leave it growing in water [3]. You can also root cuttings straight in moist potting mix [4].
